LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Title: Mod settings
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.GunsmithDesc: Configure gunsmith features and personal part tuning.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.CompatibilityDesc: Select hediffs allowed on this mod’s mechs.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.OverheatDesc: Enable the Purifier Colossus special combat mode.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.UmbraFocusDesc: When enabled, entering Blade form starts focus mode for direct manual control.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.Title: Focus mode bindings
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.Description: Click a binding to change it. Movement uses screen directions and gradually turns Umbra; the arc shows actual facing. Exiting returns to curved-blade form.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.ChargedSheath: Hold {0} for Spirit Charge; release at full charge for Spirit Roundslash. Press {1} during the charge to enter Radiant Sheathe. Alternatively, chord {0} + {1} and hold {0} for 1 second. Radiant Sheathe stays latched when keys are released; press {0} again for Offset Slash [Flash].
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.ComboRule: Press two keys within the 0.15-second input window while the first remains held to perform a combo. The first action waits until the window expires or the key is released. Holding one key for longer does not form a combo.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.Capture: Press a keyboard key, or a mouse button over the empty area of this window. Esc cancels.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.CaptureExit: Press a keyboard key, or a mouse button over the empty area of this window. Esc can be assigned here; use the button below to cancel.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.Conflict: This key is already assigned to {0}. Choose a different key.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.Focus.InvalidKey: Choose a valid keyboard or mouse button. Esc is reserved for exiting.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.DefaultGunsmithUIDe: Use GunSmithFramework's default GUI instead of WildHunt's stylized GUI.
LanguageData.ProtossMech.Settings.EliteDesc: Allows finer weapon customization through expanded gunsmith options and elite tuning.
